content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply for ESIC Baddi Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Age relaxation, Senior Resident (Against GDMO): SC/ST/OBC/PH As per rules. Other conditions: Selected candidates must have a professional indemnity policy covering the period as desired by ESIC. In case of selection, candidates must pay Rs. 50,000/- as security deposit through Demand Draft in favour of ESIC Fund Account No. 1 payable at Baddi. Candidates selected under PWD quota will be adjusted against respective categories.

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for ESIC Baddi Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates who have already completed 03 years Senior Residency need not apply under Senior Residency Scheme.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: As per Central Government rules adopted by ESIC on no work no pay basis. Tenure for specialists and senior residents is for one year extendable up to 03 years. Contract can be terminated earlier if regular candidates join or on one month's notice.

content_sections.heading: How Will ESIC Baddi Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Walk-in interview Walk-in interview at Office of Medical Superintendent, 3rd floor, ESIC Hospital, Katha, Baddi (H.P.)

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Age proof MBBS Certificate Two photographs (PP size) Caste Certificates for SC/ST/OBC Candidates PG Degree/Diploma Certificate/DM/M.Ch Certificate State Medical Council/MCI Registration Certificate No Objection Certificate from present employer, if applicable Experience Certificate if applicable

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ESIC Baddi Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Submit application form to the office of the Medical Superintendent ESIC Hospital Baddi H.P. for walk-in-interview. Bring duly filled application form with a self-attested photograph affixed. Bring original certificates and one set of self-attested photocopies of relevant documents. Bring two recent passport size photographs. Attend on 28 October 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Accreditation with NBEMS for DNB courses at ESICMH, Baddi is under process.

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for ESIC Baddi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 28 October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in ESIC Baddi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 45 vacancies: 1 Chest/ Pulmonary Medicine Specialist, 2 Medicine Specialist, 3 Obs & Gynae Specialist, 1 Orthopaedic Specialist, 1 Paediatrics Specialist, 1 Radiology Specialist and 9 more posts.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for ESIC Baddi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 28 October 2026. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. Is there an application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post - Chest/ Pulmonary Medicine Specialist: maximum 69 years; Medicine Specialist: maximum 69 years; Obs & Gynae Specialist: maximum 69 years; Orthopaedic Specialist: maximum 69 years; Paediatrics Specialist: maximum 69 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: As per Central Government rules for Chest/ Pulmonary Medicine Specialist, As per Central Government rules for Medicine Specialist, As per Central Government rules for Obs & Gynae Specialist, As per Central Government rules for Orthopaedic Specialist, As per Central Government rules for Paediatrics Specialist.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: PG Degree or Diploma / MBBS Degree in concerned specialty. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Selected candidates must have a professional indemnity policy covering the period as desired by ESIC. In case of selection, candidates must pay Rs. 50,000/- as security deposit through Demand Draft in favour of ESIC Fund Account No. 1 payable at Baddi. Candidates selected under PWD quota will be adjusted against respective categories.

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates who have already completed 03 years Senior Residency need not apply under Senior Residency Scheme.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Walk-in interview. Walk-in interview at Office of Medical Superintendent, 3rd floor, ESIC Hospital, Katha, Baddi (H.P.).
